title: Painting Fine Details with Big Brushes
content: It's possible to paint details that are much smaller than the brush itself. The subject is a snow pile in a parking lot.Snow Pile "Everest", gouache, 5 x 8 inches.Using relatively big brushes can add verve and speed to your paintings. My goal when I'm painting fast is to convey as much truthful information as I can in the time available.(Link to video on YouTube) In this video,  I show how you can capture a lot of detail with relatively big brushes.If you're experimenting with a new medium, it's helpful to do an abstract painting exercise, and try out wet and dry passages, drybrush, gradations, etc. I did this with a flat brush.
